# Let me parse the note content to extract songs that still need release month (those with TODO).
import re

lines = note["content"].split("\n")
todo_songs = []
for line in lines:
    if "RELEASED_AT TODO" in line:
        # Format: - Song BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO
        m = re.match(r'^- (.+?) BY (.+?) RELEASED_AT TODO$', line)
        if m:
            title = m.group(1)
            artists = m.group(2)
            todo_songs.append({"title": title, "artists": artists, "original_line": line})

print(f"Found {len(todo_songs)} songs needing release month:")
for s in todo_songs:
    print(f"  {s['title']} BY {s['artists']}")
